info.name: SAP Ariba Procurement Invoices Suppliers API

params.name: realm
params.description: The SAP Ariba realm identifier for the buyer organization. This is the unique site name assigned during provisioning.

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of records to skip for pagination (default 0)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return per page (default 10, max 100)

params.name: name
params.description: Search suppliers by name (partial match supported)

items.docs: Retrieves a paginated list of supplier profiles from the SAP Ariba Network. Supports filtering by supplier name, AN-ID, qualification status, commodity codes, and location.

params.name: realm
params.description: The SAP Ariba realm identifier for the buyer organization. This is the unique site name assigned during provisioning.

params.name: supplierId
params.description: Supplier AN-ID (Ariba Network ID) or internal supplier identifier

items.docs: Retrieves the complete profile details of a specific supplier including company information, contact details, addresses, certifications, commodity classifications, and qualification status.
